Name: Cream Modern Fireplace
Author: Suzilana
Description:
[ Content Patcher ] mod that transforme one of the in game fireplace to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11431]Cream Modern Kitchen[/url]﻿ 🍰 , [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12068]Cream Modern Interior[/url] ✨ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13223]Cream Modern Corner Bathroom[/url] 💄 look.

You can choose in the config file witch one it replaces between those in the furniture set : brick, stone, iridium, stove, monster or elegant. Default is brick.

💜🌈
